name: bg-falling-stars
title: Falling Stars Background
blurb: Stars stream toward the viewer with 3D perspective depth.
description: Canvas-rendered animation with 200 configurable stars using 3D perspective projection. Stars fall from top with Z-depth creating hyperspace effect.
use_when: Immersive sci-fi themed background, space-related content.
avoid_when: Performance-sensitive contexts, or when animation should remain static.
a11y: Purely decorative; no interactive elements or keyboard handling.
